§7.2.8 Links

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-links · text formatting

✅ Normative

Hyperlinks and email addresses MUST be transcribed as raw text. Link syntax — <email>, [url](url) — MAY be used only when link extraction was explicitly requested.

Default

Contact support@example.com or see https://example.com/pricing

When link extraction is requested

Contact <support@example.com> or see [https://example.com/pricing](https://example.com/pricing)

Why raw text

The output is read mostly by a model or an extraction step. Link punctuation adds noise to every chunk for a payload most readers never use. Raw text keeps the default output clean and still leaves the address recoverable.

Anchor text that differs from its target

When the printed words differ from the target — click here pointing at a long URL — the output MUST keep the printed words as they appear. Under the raw-text default the target is not represented, and it MUST NOT be added in place of, or beside, the printed words: the page does not print it (never invent).
